code:
=TRIM(PROPER(A2))
  -- "acme corp " -> "Acme Corp"

=SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(C2,"(",""),") ","-")
  -- strips phone punctuation

=TRIM(UPPER(B2))
  -- "tx"/"Texas" -> "TX"/"TEXAS" (still different!)
caption: Formulas fix case and formatting — not content. TX and TEXAS still need a picklist.
